name: createLocationsAdvanced
description: Adds several new locations at once, using category ids to file them.

title.description: The location's title, shown on the map, in lists and on its details page.

subtitle.description: A short line shown under the title. Leave it out for no subtitle.

address.description: The location's full street address, as an address search would format it. It is shown as is; the map position comes from the latitude and longitude.

latitude.description: The latitude of the location's map pin, in degrees.

longitude.description: The longitude of the location's map pin, in degrees.

addressAlias.description: A friendlier name shown in place of the address, such as a building name. Leave it out to show the address.

description.description: The location's description, shown on its details page. HTML formatting is kept, as the description editor saves it.

listImage.description: The picture shown for the location in lists and on its details page.

categoryIds.description: The ids of the categories the location is listed under, separated by commas, as the category search gives them. Every id must match a live category. Leave it out to add the location without a category.

subcategoryIds.description: The ids of the subcategories the location is listed under, separated by commas, as the category search gives them. Each must be a subcategory of one of the location's categories. Needs categoryIds. Leave it out to pick no subcategory.

priceRange.description: How pricey the location is, from $ to $$$$. Defaults to $.

priceCurrency.description: The currency sign the price range is shown with. Defaults to $.

markerType.description: How the location is drawn on the map. Defaults to a pin.

markerColor.description: The circle marker's color as an rgb() or rgba() value. Used only when the marker type is Circle; defaults to red, rgba(253,35,5,1).

markerImage.description: The picture used as the map marker. Required when the marker type is Image, ignored otherwise.

showCategory.description: Whether the location's category is shown on its details page. Defaults to true.

showOpeningHours.description: Whether the opening hours are shown on its details page. Leave it out to hide them. New locations get the plugin's standard week, open 08:00-20:00 every day; the hours themselves are edited in the plugin.

showPriceRange.description: Whether the price range is shown on its details page. Defaults to false.

showStarRating.description: Whether app users' star rating is shown on its details page. Defaults to false.

pinned.description: Whether the location is pinned to the top of the introduction screen. At most three locations can be pinned; a fourth is refused. Defaults to false.

locations.description: The locations to add, up to 50 per call. Each entry is added exactly as a single new location would be; entries carry no gallery images or action buttons.

callback.description: Runs when it's done, with each location's outcome.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as when any entry is invalid or does not resolve, in which case nothing is added.

locations.description: One outcome per input entry, in input order.

index.description: The entry's position in the input list, from 0.

id.description: The new location's id, if it worked.

error.description: Why the entry failed, if it didn't.
